item.title: Incarico post-doc: Numerical models and data analysis for space weather investigations (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Rende
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

The research activities will be carried out within the framework of the "Space It Up" project and will be dedicated to the development and implementation of high-performance computing (HPC) codes and advanced parallelization techniques for the study of turbulence in space plasmas. The main objective will be the modelling of impulsive events that formed in the upper atmosphere of the Sun (corona) and that propagate in the interplanetary space reaching the Earth environment, by making use of magnetohydrodynamics codes, such as PLUTO and EUHFORIA

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Molecular Dynamics Simulations for the Thermal Refinement of Colloidal Nanocrystals (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-04 Fisica teorica della materia, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

This position is funded by the ERC Starting Grant REFINE2LASE recipient Prof. Emanuele Marino and is part of Work Package 2, which aims to understand the physical mechanisms underlying the thermal refinement of colloidal nanocrystals. The research will involve developing coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations informed by experimental small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) data to study superlattice nucleation and growth and nanocrystal size selection. These simulations will help identify efficient thermal protocols to obtain nanocrystal populations with reduced polydispersity for use in the microlasers envisioned by the project.
